name: penumbra
description: The portable half of a design system: scale, rhythm, motion and stacking with no colour in them, and a neutral skin with no brand in it.
author: Francis Desjardins <francis.desjardins@gmail.com>

scripts.check: yarn type-check && yarn lint --deny-warnings && yarn format:check && node scripts/check-tokens.mjs && node scripts/check-contrast.mjs && yarn check:contrast && yarn check:tokens:used && yarn comment-budget
scripts.test: echo "penumbra: no-op — the package is two stylesheets; its contract is asserted by check (check-tokens, penumbra-contrast) and its demo by check:mobile"
scripts.check:contrast: node scripts/check-contrast.mjs playground/src/app/styles/tokens.skin.css && node scripts/check-contrast.mjs playground/src/app/styles/skins/tint.css && node scripts/check-contrast.mjs --no-base playground/src/app/styles/skins/replaced.css
